description: E211 s0. Why a sample of the sample index is not offered, one closed key each (samples/v1/samples.py CODES), one sentence each. `{sample}` is the sample's name as a person reads it; no sentence carries a code, a field name or a path.

reasons.index-malformed: The list of samples could not be read, so {sample} and every other sample are not offered.
reasons.entry-malformed: The description of {sample} is not complete or not in the expected form, so it is not offered.
reasons.sample-repeated: {sample} is listed more than once, so it is not offered until it is listed once.
reasons.manifest-missing: The list of what {sample} holds could not be found, so it is not offered.
reasons.sample-not-approved: {sample} is not one of the approved samples, so it is not offered.
reasons.source-refused: {sample} is made from data we do not use for samples, so it is not offered.
reasons.acquisition-host: Part of {sample} was fetched from a place its rights do not cover, so it is not offered.
reasons.licence-malformed: The licence of a part of {sample} could not be read, so it is not offered.
reasons.not-redistributable: Part of {sample} may not be shared by us, so it is not offered.
reasons.not-anonymous: Part of {sample} cannot be fetched by anyone without an account, so it is not offered.
reasons.non-commercial: Part of {sample} may not be used commercially, so it is not offered.
reasons.licence-not-listed: The licence of a part of {sample} is not one we accept for samples, so it is not offered.
reasons.commercial-use-not-read: Nobody has yet read whether {sample} may be used commercially, so it is not offered.
reasons.no-attribution-sentence: Part of {sample} must be credited and has no credit sentence, so it is not offered.
reasons.credit-not-prescribed: The credit of a part of {sample} is not the publisher's own sentence, so it is not offered.
reasons.credit-without-evidence: The credit we wrote for a part of {sample} does not say where it comes from, so it is not offered.
reasons.unsupported-combination: {sample} combines data under different licences, which a sample cannot carry, so it is not offered.
reasons.licence-block-differs: The licence shown for {sample} is not the one its data carry, so it is not offered.
reasons.manifest-differs: The list of what {sample} holds is not the one it was published with, so it is not offered.
reasons.manifest-invalid: The list of what {sample} holds is not in the expected form, so it is not offered.
reasons.manifest-repeats-item: The list of what {sample} holds names one item twice, so it is not offered.
reasons.contents-differ: What {sample} says it holds is not what its data hold, so it is not offered.
